title: SentinelOne Coverage Matrix Row
description: One row of the Phase 2 coverage matrix (Milestone 3) -- the question-class-to-retrieval spine that is both the build backlog and the Milestone 8 regression test set. A tenant's coverage_matrix is an array of these.

question_class.description: The intent class this row covers, matching the taxonomy in Sentry_Agent_Task_Execution.md section 3 (e.g. 'threat_count', 'storyline_pivot', 'agent_health').

example.description: One or more example natural-language questions that map to this row -- used both for human readability and as the embedding-router's training examples in Milestone 6.

target_entity.description: The ontology entity this question is fundamentally about (e.g. Alert, Vulnerability, InventoryItem).

source_module.description: The real source module/system that must answer this question -- e.g. 'SentinelOne Alerts' (not 'SentinelOne Threats', which does not exist as a distinct tool in this tenant's MCP server; see mcp_tools.md), 'Deep Visibility / PowerQuery', 'Vulnerability Management', 'Sentry internal findings'. The row must say so explicitly, per the grounding contract's 'name the source' rule.

retrieval_path.description: The canonical tool call (or short sequence) that answers this question, e.g. 'search_alerts(first=1) -> read totalCount'. Should reference a recipe in data/knowledge/sentinelone/recipes/ once Milestone 4 authors it.

mitre_technique.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs relevant to this question class, if applicable (mainly for DV hunt rows).

expected_result_shape.description: What a correct answer looks like structurally, e.g. 'integer count + severity breakdown', 'list of affected endpoints with patch status'.

priority.description: 'gap_closing' marks the five hard-bound intents from the brief: threat/alert count, host lookup, storyline pivot, agent health, CVE traversal.

status.description: Build status of this row's retrieval path. Only 'stable' rows are usable by the router without analyst confirmation.

forbidden_source.description: A source that would be a wrong-source answer for this question class, if there's a known confusable one (e.g. for 'threat_count', forbidden_source is 'Sentry internal findings').

elicited_by.description: Set when this row was added via the analyst-elicited-question hook rather than seeded from the tenant's modules -- who/when it was added.
